effects.name: Arcane beam
effects.desc: A beam fires right from the hand: a white core, strands twisting round it, pulses running down it, a flaring source and an end that sprays sparks.

effects.name: Arcane missiles
effects.desc: A volley of violet bolts fans out of the hand, curls round on twisting ribbons and pops on the target one after another.

effects.name: Arcane orb
effects.desc: A floating orb of smoky violet glass with a swirl turning round a white-hot heart, two tilted rings of light orbiting behind and in front.

effects.name: Blink in
effects.desc: Glittering bits spiral in to a point of light that opens into a line, then into a white silhouette that cools into the caster.

effects.name: Blink out
effects.desc: The caster crackles with gathering light, flashes white, squeezes into a line of light that collapses and pops away in sparks.

effects.name: Magic circle cast
effects.desc: A circle draws itself on the floor, runes ignite one by one, it flashes, and a column of light fires up and breaks apart into glints.

effects.name: Mana burst
effects.desc: Energy rushes into a point and blows out in a white flash and rings, flinging glowing runes that flare and pop into sparks one after another.

effects.name: Portal
effects.desc: An upright rift: fibrous spiral arms wind down into the dark, a lit rim wobbles, motes and streaks are pulled in, the floor glows.

effects.name: Rune circle
effects.desc: A rune circle turns on the floor in perspective: a carousel of runes lit by chasing light, a turning square, ticks, motes rising off it.

effects.name: Spell charge
effects.desc: Energy gathers in the caster's hand: streaks and motes spiral in, rings collapse into a swelling orb that crackles with arcs, ready to fire.

effects.name: Star fall
effects.desc: Stars streak down on long trails across an area, each landing with a white flash, a ring across the floor and a kick of sparks.

effects.name: Time stop
effects.desc: A clock face springs open, ticks slower and slower, freezes drained of colour, cracks, then shatters into falling shards.
